decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until coloured samples of the materials to be used in the screen  have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and be implemented by 5th April 2006
Condition : 4 - Noise emanating from the air conditioning units should not exceed a level at least 10db below the background noise level (LAeq) of the locality

Condition : 5 - It is considered that the air conditioning units and proposed screen will not cause audible or visible harm to the amenity of adjoining residents, nor appear out of place on the dwelling, and would also comply with the aims of policy Env-B.1.1 of the Council's 2003 UDP
description: Retention of condensing units to side elevation of house with proposed timber screen.
